# Tongjun Special Metals

Website: https://exoticalloycn.com
Legal entity: Tongjun Metal Technology (Wuxi) Co., Ltd.
Location: Wuxi, Jiangsu, China

## Positioning
Special-metals sourcing, mill qualification and non-standard material development from China. The company does not claim to manufacture every listed material itself. Manufacturing, stockholding, processing and international-origin routes are kept distinct.

## Technical navigation
- Technical data center: /technical-data

- Product forms: /product-forms
- Markets: /industries
- Standards map: /standards
- Quality and traceability: /quality
- Technical resources: /resources
- Structured technical RFQ: /rfq

## Core material routes
- Precision stainless and special-alloy strip / foil
- Nickel and corrosion alloys including UNS N06625, N08825 and N10276 routes
- Invar 36 / 4J36 low-expansion alloy routes
- Heavy and extra-wide stainless / duplex / nickel-alloy plate
- Titanium and zirconium project-material routes

## Buyer workflow
Application -> material -> product form -> dimensional capability -> qualification -> supply route -> trial / commercial supply.

## Qualification boundary
Website content is sourcing orientation, not a guarantee of current stock, mill approval, end-use qualification or dimensional capability. These are confirmed per RFQ.
